name: config-decomposer
description: Decompose, design, and grade a configuration / infrastructure-as-code artifact (YAML/HCL/JSON/TOML — CI configs, Terraform, k8s manifests, Dockerfiles, app config) on two crossing axes — INTENT (desired-state → contract → cases → drift → fit) and VALIDITY (parse → schema → plan → safety → observability) — scored separately, with VALIDITY routed to the tool's own validate/plan (a self-tested adapter) and the safety smells (plaintext secrets, :latest, 0.0.0.0/0, wildcard grants, missing limits) routed to a static linter. Doctrine: the PLAN is the contract — a config's behavior is its diff against current state, not its text. Backed by a gated rubric and a config-spec + plan-verdict protocol.
